name: full
description: Camera-ready / ARR June expansion suite: 8 main + 4 expansion benchmarks (RealWorldQA, BLINK, OCRBench, DocVQA-val). ~24-30h per checkpoint. Only run this once a method has cleared the main_table gate. HallusionBench can be added as a 13th if hallucination is a focus.

notes.RealWorldQA: Real-world image reasoning, ~765 samples. Robust signal.
notes.BLINK: Visual-perception binary tasks; 2017 questions. Sensitive to vision encoder quality.
notes.DocVQA_VAL: Document image QA. Heavy overlap with OCRBench at 2B scale; consider dropping if compute-bound.
